payload.reason: The evidence provides clear motivations for the authors to experiment with their model on CNN/DailyMail, highlighting the effectiveness of hierarchical structure information in improving summarization performance.

claims.text: The authors aimed to improve extractive summarization by injecting hierarchical structure information into their model, which was evaluated on CNN/DailyMail among other datasets.
The performance improvements on CNN/DailyMail were smaller compared to other datasets, indicating the dataset's less conspicuous hierarchical structure.
The HiStruct+ model outperformed baselines on CNN/DailyMail, demonstrating the effectiveness of the hierarchical position information.
